content: If EthSwtLowPowerModeSupport is set to TRUE and at least one EthSwtPort of a Ethernet switch is enabled and the corresponding Ether- net switch HW is in an inactive or low power mode the Ethernet switch HW shall be set to an active mode in which forwarding of Ethernet frames is possible.
